""" title = to_string(item.get("title", "No title")) content = to_string(item.get(content_key, [])) return title, content def get_crawler_config(self) -> CrawlerRunConfig: """ Costruisce la configurazione di esecuzione del crawler. """ config_kwargs = {"extraction_strategy": self._create_extraction_strategy()} if self.WAIT_FOR: config_kwargs["wait_for"] = self.WAIT_FOR if self.PAGE_TIMEOUT: config_kwargs["page_timeout"] = self.PAGE_TIMEOUT return CrawlerRunConfig(**config_kwargs) async def crawl(self, url: str, file_url: str = "") -> dict[str, str]: """ Esegue il crawling di un URL e restituisce i dati estratti. Args: url: URL da processare (str). file_url: URL del file HTML da parsare (str). Returns: Dizionario con URL, dominio, titolo, HTML e testo parsato (dict[str, str]). """ # Controlla se l'URL è nel gold standard crwl_url = url if url_exists_in_gs(url): existing_file_path = get_saved_gs_html_path(url) if existing_file_path: logger.info( "✓ URL trovato nel gold standard, file locale gia presente..." ) crwl_url = f"file://{existing_file_path}" logger.info(f"✓ Usando: {crwl_url}") else: logger.info("✓ URL trovato nel gold standard, salvo file locale...") file_path = save_gs_html(url) if file_path: # Converti il path a un URL file:// crwl_url = f"file://{file_path}" logger.info(f"✓ Usando: {crwl_url}") # se viene passato un file_url, usalo al posto dell'URL originale (utile per il parsing di HTML salvati localmente) elif file_url: crwl_url = file_url logger.info(f"✓ Usando file_url: {crwl_url}") async with AsyncWebCrawler(config=self.browser_config) as crawler: result = await crawler.arun(url=crwl_url, config=self.get_crawler_config()) if not result.success: raise Exception(f"Errore: {result.error_message}") data = json.loads(result.extracted_content) item = data[0] if isinstance(data, list) else data title, parsed_text = self.process_content(item) html_text = self._extract_html(result, url) output = { "url": url, "domain": self.domain, "title": title, "html_text": html_text, "parsed_text": parsed_text, } self._save_to_file(title, output) return output def _extract_html(self, result: Any, url: str) -> str: """ Estrae il campo HTML dal risultato del crawler. """ safe_title = file_name_sanitize(title) filename = CRAWLED_DIR / f"crawled_{safe_title}.json" Path(filename).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(output, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) logger.info(f"✓ Salvato: {filename}") --- # FILE: frontend/src/main.py | SERVIZIO: frontend # TIPO: FUNCTION | NOME: api_db_stats # ENDPOINT API: app.get('/api/db_stats') --- IMPORTS DI CONTESTO --- from __future__ import annotations from typing import Any import requests from requests.exceptions import ChunkedEncodingError from fastapi import FastAPI, Request from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse, PlainTextResponse, StreamingResponse from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates from .logcon import get_logger from config import BACKEND_URL, ESPERTO_URL, FRONTEND_TEMPLATES_DIR, LOGS_FILE from .classi import ParseFrontendRequest, EvaluateFrontendRequest, AddWebResourceFrontendRequest, AddGoldStandardFrontendRequest, ChatFrontendRequest, UrlFrontendRequest --- CODICE SORGENTE --- def api_db_stats(): data, error = _backend_request( "/db_stats", timeout=60, include_error_body=True, ) if error or data is None: return JSONResponse( status_code=502, content={"error": error or "Errore recupero statistiche DB"}, ) return JSONResponse(content=data) --- # FILE: backend/src/crawler/backend.py | SERVIZIO: backend # TIPO: FUNCTION | NOME: _get_crawler_for_url --- IMPORTS DI CONTESTO --- import tempfile from anyio import Path from ..log import get_logger from typing import Dict, Optional from ..utilities import estrattore_dominio, validate_supported_domain from .crawler_oop import Crawler, WikipediaCrawler, EuropeanCouncilCrawler, TradingEconomicsCrawler, BorsaItalianaCrawler from ..database.db_manipolation import DatabaseManipulator --- CODICE SORGENTE --- def _get_crawler_for_url(url: str) -> Crawler: """ Restituisce l'istanza crawler associata al dominio dell'URL.
